proposals.title: PROPOSAL 4 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SUPPLEMENTAL PAY EQUITY DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: Robert and Mary McInnes, c/o Arjuna Capital
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Nike report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks, at reasonable cost.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 5 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT REPORT
proposals.proponent: Tulipshare Ltd., c/o Tulipshare Capital LLC
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report assessing supply chain infrastructure alignment with equity goals and human rights commitments, including forced labor and wage theft risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 6 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING WORKER-DRIVEN SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY
proposals.proponent: Domini Impact Equity Fund and other co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating how worker-driven social responsibility principles and binding agreements would affect identifying and remediating human rights issues in high-risk sourcing.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 7 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING ENVIRONMENTAL TARGETS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing failure to meet FY15-20 sustainability targets, governance around sustainability, and measures to achieve sustainability objectives.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 8 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A DIVISIVE PARTNERSHIPS CONGRUENCY REPORT
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report listing and analyzing voluntary partnerships and whether partners' agendas are congruent with the Company's fiduciary duty to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response
